# All PC Repair - AI & LLM Service Directory

> All PC Repair delivers enterprise-grade IT consulting, computer repair, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, VoIP, and managed IT services across the Hampton Roads region of Virginia (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Newport News, Hampton, Suffolk).

## Business Summary
- **Company Name**: All PC Repair & IT Solutions
- **Primary Website**: https://www.allpcrepairva.com
- **Phone**: +1-757-559-1231
- **Email**: info@allpcrepairva.com
- **Service Region**: Hampton Roads, VA (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Newport News, Hampton, Suffolk)
- **Specializations**: Managed IT Services, Hardware & PC Repair Diagnostics, Cybersecurity Audits, Cloud Migration, Virtual CISO, VoIP Telecom, Technology Procurement.

## Services Offered
1. **Computer Repair & Hardware Diagnostics**:
   - Component diagnosis, SSD/RAM upgrades, motherboard repairs, malware removal, liquid damage restoration, custom PC builds.
2. **Managed IT Services**:
   - 24/7 network monitoring, proactive helpdesk support, server maintenance, endpoint protection, automated patching.
3. **Cybersecurity & Compliance**:
   - Risk assessment, Virtual CISO (vCISO), endpoint detection & response (EDR), security awareness training, firewall management.
4. **Cloud & Web Infrastructure**:
   - Cloud migrations (AWS, Azure, Microsoft 365), hybrid cloud architecture, disaster recovery, secure cloud backup, web hosting.
5. **VoIP Telephony & Communication**:
   - Unified cloud communications, SIP trunking, interactive IVR systems, mobile integration.
6. **Data Center & Tech Procurement**:
   - Server rack management, network cabling, enterprise hardware sourcing, lifecycle asset management.

## Key Interactive Features
- **AI Service Cost & Repair Estimator**: Interactive playground tool located on `/what-we-do` allowing clients to calculate instant cost estimates for hardware repair, network setup, managed IT, and cybersecurity audits.
